description: Plans a doubles and singles lineup for a team the Desk covers. It lists who has played most for your team this season, with their appearances, usual line and Desk level, the Desk's estimate of how they play now. Against a covered opponent it adds each line's win chance, each team's Desk level there and the expected number of lines won. Call it for 'what lineup should we play against X', 'who has played most for us' or 'how do we beat X'. Pass `unavailable` for your players who are out, but pass `lineup` only for the players the person put on each line. Needs a Desk Pass after the member's free forecast each week. Past that, a call gets the free part, with no chance for anything still to be played, and `deskPass`, whose `message` you give the person. Its error is free_forecast_used, or desk_pass_required for a key with no member.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

lineup.description: Your own team's lineup, only as the person states it, line by line. Never fill it in yourself. Each line named is read from those players.

players.description: Your players on that line: one for singles, two for doubles. Names may be abbreviated ('Jane').

opponent.description: The opponent team to plan against, by name or Desk page link. Optional.

season.description: Season year. Defaults to the current season.

team.description: Your team, e.g. 'Belvedere 18AM3.5A', or its Desk page link or number. Must be a covered team.

unavailable.description: Players on YOUR team who are out. They leave your list and the averages your side of each line is read from. Names may be abbreviated ('Jane').

name: plan_lineup
title: Your lineup and line chances
